retrieval_skill.name: regime_stability_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Identify recent operational changes that define the active regime, then retrieve evidence about the metric’s stability, drift, and fluctuation pattern within the forecast window.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting an operational time series that may have shifted after an update, repair, configuration change, or other regime boundary.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for authoritative records of recent regime-changing events and window-specific observations of the target metric; prioritize sources that explicitly connect the event to the resulting behavior and characterize the full horizon.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when the source establishes provenance, places the regime change before or within the relevant temporal window, and directly supports the stated stability or drift pattern across that window; preserve exact wording when quotes are required and reject extrapolation beyond the evidence.
